description_en: Refreshes a Weboffice access token. A Weboffice access token is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, you can no longer access Weboffice. To continue accessing Weboffice, call this operation to refresh the Weboffice access token and obtain a new token that is also valid for 30 minutes
description_zh: 刷新Weboffice访问凭证。Weboffice访问凭证有效期是30分钟，过期会失效，无法继续访问Weboffice。如果要继续访问Weboffice，可以使用这个接口刷新Weboffice访问凭证，即获取一个新的凭证，新的凭证过期时间也是30分钟
kebab_example: aliyun imm refresh-weboffice-token --project-name test-project --access-token 99d1b8b478b641c1b3372f5bd600000000 --refresh-token a730ae0d7c6a487d87c661d19900000000 --credential-config example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefreshWebofficeToken

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The Weboffice access token. You can obtain the token by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478226.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478227.html operation
parameters.help_zh: Weboffice 访问凭证。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478226.html接口或者https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478227.html接口获取
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The Weboffice refresh token. You can obtain the token by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478226.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478227.html operation
parameters.help_zh: Weboffice 刷新凭证。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478226.html接口或者https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478227.html接口获取
parameters.name: refresh_token

fields.help_en: The ID of the account that you use to grant permissions
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The RAM role that can be assumed
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:

user: Alibaba Cloud account.
service: Alibaba Cloud service
fields.help_zh:
角色类型，可选值如下。
user：阿里云账号。
service：阿里云服务
fields.name: role_type

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
fields.name: chain

fields.help_en: The policy that is attached to the role specified by the ServiceRole parameter. For example, the policy allows access to OSS. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: ServiceRole参数的角色所需配置的权限策略，例如允许访问OSS。可选
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The service role in the account that is used to call an IMM API operation. The role must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You can configure permissions for the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console
fields.help_zh: 服务角色，调用IMM接口的账号需要创建的一个角色，必须包含 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行配置
fields.name: service_role

parameters.help_en:
Leave this parameter empty unless you have special requirements.

The China authorization configuration. This parameter is optional. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.help_zh:
如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可。

链式授权配置，非必填。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.name: credential_config

AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the access token. The access token expires in 30 minutes. Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision
AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 访问凭证的过期时间。过期时间30分钟。格式为：ISO 8601 UTC 时间戳（毫秒级精度）

RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the refresh token. The refresh token expires in 1 day. Format: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision
RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 刷新凭证的过期时间。过期时间 1 天。格式为：ISO 8601 UTC 时间戳（毫秒级精度）
